name: Gospel The
overview: The Gospel is revealed in Isaiah 61:1-3 as the anointed message of liberation and restoration, sent by the Spirit of the Lord to heal the brokenhearted and proclaim freedom to captives. It announces the acceptable year of the Lord, offering comfort to those who mourn and transforming sorrow into joy and praise. This divine proclamation glorifies God by calling His people to righteousness, emphasizing the Gospel's power to bring peace, salvation, and spiritual renewal.
